title: Asteroid Drift
description:
Asteroid Drift is a challenging spaceship piloting arcade game.

Alone on a collapsing asteroid. Weave your way through 26 nail-biting, butt-clenching deep space tunnels.

Levels go by fast, and victory is all about deft handling of your inertia and momentum. Ultimately, your goal is to not explode, and you're scored based on how much time is left on the clock when you finish a level.

Easy to learn, hard to master physicsControlling your ship couldn't be simpler. Press left or right to turn clockwise or counterclockwise, and hold thrust to propel forward. Controllers are supported too, so play whatever way you're most comfortable! But beware, actually mastering control of your spacecraft's inertia is no small feat.

Designed for Time Attack and replayAsteroid Drift was designed with time attack replay and speedrunning in mind. The faster you complete a level, the higher the medal you'll receive. There's Bronze, Silver, Gold, and maybe even something beyond that if you want to put in the work. Struggling players are also welcome to opt for extra time or hp to practice completing levels before chasing those high score medals.

Asteroid Drift tends to take about 2 hours to roll credits the first time, but 7:21.64 is the speedrun time to beat - "Nick's Time," may it live in infamy.
description_short: Alone on a collapsing asteroid. Weave your way through 26 nail-biting, butt-clenching deep space tunnels, where victory is about deft handling of inertia and momentum. Go faster, score higher.
